Detail: Reference for how Maja generates polls/quizzes every ~4 hours
OPENAI_MODEL default gpt-4o-mini (OpenRouter if key starts with sk-or-)
Two pools: (1) English Content Agent invents EN cards; (2) Hindi Content Agent invents original HI cards (not localization).
~20 cards per onboarding category per refresh
No short TTL — previous live moments retired only after the new batch is live
bollywood, mythology, tv-serials, cricket, indian-foods, football, general-knowledge, kpop, boys-girls, math-puzzles, memory-games, word-puzzles, maths
debate, hot, hypothetical, opinion, social_debate, versus
challenge, debate, hypothetical, opinion, prediction, versus

Agent System Prompt = English-only LLM system message. Agent User Payload = JSON user message schema including allowedFormats + typesByFormat. Shared Rules = rules[] sent every category. Category Scope/Rules = per-slug taxonomy extras. Evergreen Polls/Quizzes = bank templates. Brief Templates = verified event cards. Meme/FTD Pack = image spice. Hindi Generate = separate HI invent agent. Trends Input = ops India trends JSON.
Ops fill backend/scripts/content_gen/trends/{category}.json before refresh. Merged with briefs into verifiedTrends. Model must not invent trending claims.
